function registerInstitution(address institutionWallet, string name) external
function setInstitutionActive(address institutionWallet, bool isActive) external
function issueCertificate(bytes32 certificateId, bytes32 certificateHash, string metadataURI) external
function revokeCertificate(bytes32 certificateId, string reason) external

function verifyCertificate(bytes32 certificateId, bytes32 hashToCheck) external view returns (bool exists, bool hashMatches, uint8 status, address issuer, string issuerName, uint64 issuedAt, uint64 revokedAt, string metadataURI)
function getCertificate(bytes32 certificateId) external view returns (tuple(bytes32 certificateHash, address issuer, uint64 issuedAt, uint64 revokedAt, uint8 status, string metadataURI))
function institutions(address) external view returns (bool isRegistered, bool isActive, string name, uint64 registeredAt)
event CertificateIssued(bytes32 indexed certificateId, address indexed issuer, bytes32 certificateHash, string metadataURI)
event CertificateRevoked(bytes32 indexed certificateId, address indexed issuer, string reason)
